cases.name: P0-canonical
cases.reason: canonical signature-positive payload in a single TCP segment

cases.name: P1-boundary-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split at parser and required-content boundaries

cases.name: P2-many-small-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split into many small TCP segments

cases.name: P3-retransmission
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload with one byte-identical retransmitted data segment

cases.name: N-meta-tag-changed
cases.reason: response advertises a different meta tag name

cases.name: N-version-out-of-range
cases.reason: advertised major version 3 is outside the affected range

cases.name: N-version-without-minor-separator
cases.reason: advertised version omits the minor-version separator the PCRE requires

cases.name: N-external-response-source
cases.reason: response is served by a host outside the monitored network

cases.name: N-flow-not-established
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent without a completed TCP handshake

cases.name: N-wrong-direction
cases.reason: canonical payload is replayed to server; http.response_body is only populated for responses

cases.name: N-random-http-response
cases.reason: protocol-valid HTTP response that satisfies no combination of rule predicates
